name: Time Range
description: Provides the form widget to fill in time range.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Time Range
 
 Provide the form widget to fill in the time range. This is just a change to the display form, so that the user doesn't need to enter too much content.

This module not store time data. The storage of time is provided by the core. 

 Back to top 

 Installation
 
 Install the module as every other module.

 Back to top 

 Usage 
 
 Enable the Time Range module. 
 Create a Date Range field, select Day and time as field type. 
 To select Time range, go to your content type's Form Display Settings(Manage form display) and select Time Range as Date Range filed's WIDGET. 
 
 Because it doesn't require you to fill out the date, the default record is the date of the day. Other tips: If you don't want to see the date on the content's display, go to your content type's display settings and change the Date/Time format in your style.

 Back to top 

 Compatibility
 
 This module is compatible with Drupal core 8.x, 9.x, 10.x. 

 Back to top
